label: Outlook from historical patterns. Not a forecast of actual fires.
definition: Probability that a 0.25 deg cell (~25 km) has notable burning in that month: at least 10 harmonized fire cell-days (S-NPP scale), based on the 10 years before 2027. Missing months (no satellite record yet) count as missing, not zero.
model: RandomForestClassifier (scikit-learn), features from past years only
